title: Valid Anagram
statement:
Decide whether two words are anagrams of each other.

The input is one line with two lowercase words separated by a space. Two words are anagrams when they use exactly the same letters, each one the same number of times, in any order, like `listen` and `silent`. A word is an anagram of itself. Print `true` when the two words are anagrams and `false` otherwise.

Input:

```text
anagram nagaram
```

Expected output:

```text
true
```
hints: Words of different lengths can never be anagrams.
Count how many times each letter appears in the first word, then take away one for each letter of the second word. The words are anagrams when every count ends at 0.
A map from each letter to its count works. With only the 26 lowercase letters, a list of 26 counts works too, where a letter's spot is how far it is from `a` (`c - 'a'` in C++, Java, and Go).
